text:
viv: quick sync -- I sketched a complementary "safety-sweeper" that runs after canary for 20-40m to catch latent regressions (route-specific slowburns, semantic drift). thinking it should be route-aware and surface the minimal set of queries that bumped the score.
otto: route-aware is great. do we score per-route or per-tenant? might need both (multi-tenant routes can mask single-tenant regressions).
keisha: i'd vote per-tenant->per-route waterfall scoring. compute a tenant-level score as the weighted max of route scores. keeps blast radius small.
viv: yep waterfall. scoring idea: normalize signals, apply per-signal weight, then transparent additive score. we expose per-signal contribution in UI.
oncall-bot: Reminder: any auto-cutover must produce a PD alert, include runbook URL, and allow a 3m operator ack window.
priya: how do we prevent oscillation if a route is flaky? we should include sample-level pinning: only cutover if X distinct sample buckets show same anomaly across windows (avoid single noisy outlier).
sam: add a decay function so the canary's score integrates history with exponential smoothing. smoothing factor should be org-configurable.
viv: rough config proto I used in the demo: ```json
{
  "sweeper": {
    "window_sec": 300,
    "windows_required": 4,
    "decay_alpha": 0.6,
    "modes": ["auto","assisted","manual"],
    "signals": [
      {"name":"p95_latency","threshold_ms":1000,"weight":0.35},
      {"name":"error_rate","threshold_pct":0.4,"weight":0.35},
      {"name":"embed_drift","threshold":0.22,"weight":0.15},
      {"name":"perplexity_delta","threshold":0.12,"weight":0.15}
    ],
    "cutover_score": 0.75,
    "cooldown_sec": 3600
  }
}
```
keisha: nice. For private deployments the agent should only emit signed decision summaries (no raw samples) unless customer opts-in.
priya: auditability concern: store a compact anchor set (hashes of sample ids + trace ids) and the aggregated metric snapshot at decision time for reproducibility. we must be able to re-run the decision logic offline and get same result.
viv: agreed. decision_id + anchor_hash + config_version should be enough to reproduce. we'll also record SDK version for the agent.
otto: what's the mitigation path? immediate traffic shift to primary, or graceful ramp down?
sam: default: reduce canary to 0% over 30s for hard failures; for soft failures shift to 5% while paging SREs and opening an approval task. config per org.
keisha: also add 'traffic escrow' flag: on concern we can escrow new sessions (don't send new sessions to canary) but let existing sessions finish. helps conversational continuity.
priya: operator UX: PD alert should include one-click actions: "pause canary", "reduce to X%", "open investigate ticket" (pre-filled). require reason for manual overrides.
oncall-bot: Deploy note: sweeper feature-flag off by default. will enable for staging tomorrow 04:00 UTC.
viv: telemetry hooks: every decision emits a compact vector: [score, per-signal values, top-3 query-anchors, route-list]. we'll compress but preserve enough to triage.
otto: any thoughts on ML-eval signals (quality)? they are delayed and sparse.
priya: integrate evals as a low-weight but high-precision signal. treat eval alerts as amplification of other signals (i.e., multiplier on error_score).
sam: final ask: we need a test harness that replays historical traces and injects synthetic drift to validate parameters. I'll own this.
viv: perfect. i'll open the PR with the config proto, agent contract, and a short runbook draft. thanks everyone. :rocket:
